details: For every nonempty finite class, the stronger bound $\mathrm{TD}(\mathcal H)\leq|\mathcal H|-1$ holds.
proof: Fix $h\in\mathcal H$. For each other $h'\in\mathcal H$, choose one coordinate on which h and $h'$ differ. The union of these at most $|\mathcal H|-1$ coordinates is a teaching set for h. Maximize over h.
name: Size / Teaching Dimension
witness_verification: For #classes/singletons with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity. Thus no reverse affine-linear bound holds. See the database-owned endpoint value proofs.
